title: The Self Has Four Quarters
meter: Prose (the Upanishad mantras have no meter)
meterNote: The mantras of the Mandukya Upanishad are prose, not verse, so there is no meter to scan. Their rhythm comes from the chant. Notice how this mantra uses pada and matra, the same two words the meter scanner is built on.
translation: All this is indeed Brahman. This Self is Brahman. This Self has four quarters.
translation_hi: यह सब ब्रह्म ही है। यह आत्मा ब्रह्म है। यह आत्मा चार पादों वाला है।

words.note: catur + pad. pada = foot, quarter: the same word as a quarter of a verse!

grammar: A great saying (mahavakya): अयमात्मा ब्रह्म 'this Self is Brahman' is one of the four mahavakyas of the Upanishads.
Pada = quarter: the Self has four padas just as an Anushtubh verse has four padas of eight syllables.
r → sh: चतुर् + पात् → चतुष्पात्. Before p, r becomes a visarga and then sh.
